_comment: A made-up sharpened job's stored result: what topo/sharpen.py reports plus what topo/worker.py adds, as the API reads it from topo_jobs.sharpen. Read by topo/tests/test_sharpen.py (TestResult), topo/tests/test_worker_helpers.py (TestProcessSharpen) and api/src/services/sharpenedAreas.unit.test.ts, so the writer and the reader cannot drift apart.
